meta_description:
17K likes, 201 comments - casarthakahuja on October 9, 2026: "A company is paying Indians to watch cricket matches all day...

As per a job listing on Mercor, they are looking for Indians whose job will be to watch the T20 India matches live, and while watching, ask questions to AI on things such as:

1/ What is the probability of this team winning the match
2/ What are the current stats of this team or this player
3/ Provide an expert style analysis of this shot

Basically, questions that a cricket fan would ask and be interested in...

These questions are to be asked across two AI chatbots simultaneously, capture the screenshots of the answer, and rate the AI’s answers to say if they were good, bad, accurate, or need improvement.

The payment being offered is USD 20 per task...

While this was just one... there are several jobs listed for you to rate the work of AI as an expert... offering anywhere between USD 20 to 2000 per task

If you go to websites like Mercor, Micro1, Data Annotation Tech...

You can either search for “India” as a keyword that shows opportunities relevant to India and pay up to USD 45k per annum...

Or look for opportunities in your domain like healthcare, accounting, finance, teaching...

The hack is to have a solid resume to upload, and an updated Linkedin account, which has enough keywords relevant to the task, so that you get selected.

If AI is going to take your job sooner or later, might as well make some while training it.

#casarthakahuja".
